thread:
sasha: FYI we just got a CS escalation from Acme about widespread 5xx/timeouts hitting their hosted inference endpoints in ap-south. customer seeing ~30% request failures since ~08:10 UTC :boom:

cs_jen: Copy. They reported high latency then 502/504. Are we seeing other tenants?

mike: Yes, dashboards show p50/p95 jump and a spike in gateway 5xxs starting 08:07 UTC from AP cluster ap-south-2. Correlation with a backend keepalive thrash.

eng_oncall: I'm jumping in. Running quick checks now. pinging logs for that timeframe.

ops_lin: Noted. Autoscaler didn't spin up extra workers for the initial spike, looks like buffer thresholds didn't trigger.

sasha: CS flagged billing impact too — some requests retried by clients, ballooned cost for them. They want short remediation + comms.

eng_oncall: repro attempt: curl against hosted endpoint returns intermittent 502, stack trace shows upstream proto error. Snippet: ```
ERROR 2026-03-18T08:09:12Z gateway.proxy: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = upstream response closed while streaming
```

olivia: Thanks. I'm seeing a KV cache eviction storm in the same window in our logs. KV miss rate jumped 40x. Might be cascading cold starts + keepalive resets.

mike: Also saw a surge of long-lived connections from a single API key for Acme — high concurrency + long seq-len. Could be exhausting runtime conn pool.

cs_jen: Acme says they did a test run that increased batch size and used streaming — might explain conn longevity. They've paused the test at our ask.

eng_oncall: Short mitigation plan: 1) throttle that API key at edge (temporary rate limit) 2) route Acme traffic to fallback model variant (smaller) to reduce compute per request 3) enable aggressive KV warmup on the AP pool for next 15m. Implementing now.

ops_lin: Applying rate limit rule: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/rate-limits -d '{"key":"acct-acme","rps":20}'` -> applied.

deploy-bot: deploy started: enable-kv-warmup-ap-south-2026-03-18 by olivia (sha abc123)

eng_oncall: Routing policy changed for acct-acme -> model:redwood-small-1 for 30m. Confirming decreased failures.

mike: After throttle + routing we see 5xxs drop to baseline, p95 returned to normal within 6 minutes. Customer reports improved behavior.

cs_jen: I'm drafting a customer note summarizing what we did and next steps. Will send high-level comms in 15m.

sasha: Great. Please escalate to postmortem and list action items. Also CS wants billing credit discussion — flagging finance.

product_lead: Need root cause and fixes that prevent recurrence. Suggest we track immediate and medium-term actions in a single ticket.

olivia: Quick RCA notes: root cause = combination of (a) customer test causing sustained high concurrency with long streaming connections, (b) keepalive resets causing KV cache churn and cold seqlen, (c) autoscaler buffer threshold misconfigured for our AP pool so new workers lagged. That combo caused backend to return upstream closures leading to gateway 502s/504s.

eng_oncall: Creating incident ticket INF-7893 with timeline, logs, and mitigations performed. Assigning owners: autoscaler fix -> ops_lin, keepalive tuning -> mike, KV warmup/heuristics -> olivia, billing/comms -> cs_jen.

ops_lin: Action item 1: Adjust autoscaler buffer to 30% for ap-south-2 and add surge detection rule. ETA 48h. JIRA INF-7893-1.

mike: Action item 2: Change gateway connection pooling to prefer http1 streaming fallback and reduce max idle time to 30s to avoid half-closed conn accumulation. ETA 72h. JIRA INF-7893-2.

olivia: Action item 3: Implement proactive KV warmup for high-variance customers and add a cache-miss alert (threshold: >5% miss 5m). ETA 5 days. JIRA INF-7893-3.

cs_jen: Action item 4: Customer comms + billing review. I'll coordinate with finance for potential credit. Will post comms draft to the ticket. ETA 8h. JIRA INF-7893-4.

product_lead: Action item 5: Docs update — best practices for long streaming + batching and recommended per-tenant rate limits. Assign to product. ETA 7 days. JIRA INF-7893-5.

sasha: Also suggest adding a short-term runtime fallback: if model runtime latency > p90 threshold for 2m, automatically route to smaller quantized variant. Discuss in follow-up.

eng_oncall: Noted. I'll prototype fallback logic and include safety checks. INF-7893-6.

mike: Quick patch rolled to gateway to tighten circuit-breaker thresholds for streaming endpoints. Canary looks good. deploy-bot: canary-checks passed.

deploy-bot: deploy success: gateway-cb-tighten-2026-03-18 (canary 2/2, region ap-south-2).

olivia: Post-incident checklist: collect heap/disk/kv metrics for the window, collect connection counts per API key, export a seqlen distribution for Acme's requests (for model sizing).

cs_jen: CS next steps: send initial apology + status now, follow-up with more details and offer credit after finance review. I've scheduled a 1:1 with Acme CS lead at 14:00 UTC.

sasha: Thanks team. Let's treat this as high priority but avoid over-communicating internal technical chatter to the customer. Keep ticket INF-7893 updated with clear owner and ETA on each action.

product_lead: We'll do a 30m postmortem sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC to review root cause and decide on permanent mitigations.

eng_oncall: Final note: collected core dumps and runtime traces, saved in S3 `s3://analysis/INF-7893/` with access for oncall and SRE.

ops_lin: I'll follow up once autoscaler buffer change is staged in staging for validation.

mike: If anyone wants the exact log dump I clipped the key lines: ```
[08:07:59] conn_pool: open 1024 -> pool_exhausted
[08:08:12] kv_cache: miss-rate=42%
[08:08:13] gateway.proxy: upstream response closed while streaming
```

cs_jen: Sending initial customer note now. Will paste thread into INF-7893. :email: 

sasha: Closing war-room channel for this run. Keep updates in INF-7893 and reconvene at the 30m postmortem if anything new crops up. :checkered_flag:
